notes.title: Two New Playable Characters added to Super Pillow Fight`
notes.content:
Our newest update brings two more playable fighters into the fray, including the 'Ginger' the adorable gingerbread girl and the story-mode's powerful end boss 'Your Mom', now playable for the first time!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Full Controller Support and Story additions!
notes.content:
[b] CONTROLLER SUPPORT [/b] 

We are happy to announce a new update with full controller support for all major gamepads and joysticks. The new remapping solution should enable you to use any controller you like and is accessible from the options menu.

[b] STORY MODE UPDATE [/b] 

Story Mode now features 2 additional cinematics and accompanying fights for JaeQuellen Jones and E. Hyundai!

[b] NEXT UPDATE [/b] 

We have another update coming soon which will fix the current issue with Steam Achievements and further extend the Story Mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32305925/b3f5422d295a1a58cb71bebb5b708a4f62a03a1c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Super Pillow Fight is now available!
notes.content:
We are so happy to announce that after a year of hard work our crazy fighting odyssey is ready to show! We have lots of exciting updates planned for the coming weeks including:

More Achievements!
Additional Story Sequences!
New Combat Stages!
Additional Summons!

And much more!
